name: Supplier Invoice Three-Way Match Check
outcome: Decide whether a supplier invoice is safe to pay in two independent stages: match the invoice against its purchase order and goods receipt line by line, with quantity, price-tolerance, and totals checks plus duplicate-invoice suspicion screening (ART-701), then recompute the invoice's line VAT, tax subtotals, and grand total under the declared rounding convention and compare against the document-asserted amounts (ART-294), closing with a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). Arithmetic checks only; not a fraud determination and not tax advice.
